Vaultofill — Test Form Corpus

Fourteen self-contained form pages for exercising the DOM→schema synthesis, matching, fill, and submit pipeline. Each page is fully offline (embedded CSS/JS, no external assets) and deliberately uses a different markup pattern for its fields.

Every form validates on submit and shows a pass/fail banner — submission is inert (preventDefault), so the validator is the submit outcome.
